title: FEMA review signals shift to state-led disaster management
summary: A recent review of FEMA offers hints at some of the challenges local governments may face in preparing for future disasters and large-scale emergencies.

title: Nevada names client services chief as new statewide CTO
summary: Michael D. Smith, a former client services division chief for the state, said he wants to turn the state's strategy "into operational playbooks, guardrails, and measurable outcomes."

title: Mississippi governor launches statewide AI education ‘framework’
summary: Mississippi's new framework is intended to be "structured, stage-by-stage map" to help learners of all ages advance their AI skills.

title: State IT officials make a case for cyber grant reauthorization before House subcommittee
summary: "We are being asked to manage nation-state risks while our federal partners step back,” Colin Ahern, New York State’s director of security and intelligence, told House lawmakers.

title: Inside New Mexico’s push to build a quantum startup hub
summary: Decades ago, Microsoft spun out of Sandia National Labs and left New Mexico. Officials there said they haven't forgotten and that they don't intend to repeat the mistake.

title: California Gov. Newsom signs executive order to prepare workforce for AI disruption
summary: California state agencies are required to study potential labor market shifts tied to AI adoption, such as including layoffs, hiring changes and skills gaps.

title: To fight deed fraud, Maryland considers the blockchain
summary: Maryland’s governor has approved legislation ordering the state taxation agency to evaluate whether blockchain is a viable solution to its deed fraud problem. Not everyone is convinced it’s a good idea.

title: Pennsylvania launches higher education dashboards to track workforce trends
summary: Pennsylvania school board launched statewide higher-education data dashboards to track workforce trends across the commonwealth.

title: Kansas debuts digital platform replacing 60-year-old paper-driven regulation system
summary: A new digital platform is hoped to provide transparency, accessibility and speed to a system that's more than 60 years old.

title: California Gov. Newsom appoints new data chief
summary: California Gov. Gavin Newsom has appointed John Ohanian, former chief data officer of the state's human services agency, as the new statewide CDO.
